subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Which canonical fix path should maintainers use for the Control UI `/model list` and `/model status` bug?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the linked fix attempts are conflicting, proof-blocked, or closed unmerged; automation should not queue another fix until maintainers choose whether to refresh, replace, or close those branches.

options.title: Close stale attempts and land a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting linked PRs, then land one current-main patch aligned with docs and shared directive behavior.

options.title: Refresh an existing linked PR
options.body: Ask one contributor to rebase and revise their PR so `list` and `status` use the documented flows and include after-fix proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor proof
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new fix lane until an existing contributor returns with a mergeable, proven update.

recommendation.title: Close stale attempts and land a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting linked PRs, then land one current-main patch aligned with docs and shared directive behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest routing candidate from recent slash-command/model-command work in the affected Control UI path.
